name: Monte Carlo
description: The Monte Carlo MCP server gives Claude direct access to your data & AI observability platform. Query alerts, explore lineage, create monitors, and evaluate AI agent performance across your entire data stack.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Monte Carlo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Monte Carlo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getmontecarlo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Monte Carlo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monte Carlo lists 25 MCP tools, including getAlerts, updateAlert, setAlertOwner, createOrUpdateAlertComment, search, getTable, getQueriesForTable, getQueryData, getAssetLineage, getDownstreamBiReports, getMonitors, and getAudiences.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Monte Carlo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Monte Carlo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Monte Carlo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monte Carlo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Monte Carlo is developed by Monte Carlo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
